lesson: Class — 11 Oct: a trip to the village
grammar: Past tense in the third person (اِسْتَيْقَظَ، أَكَلَ، شَرِبَ، ذَهَبَ، رَأَى، اِشْتَرَى، جَلَسُوا، شَرِبُوا)، ordinals with the noun (بَيْضَةً أُولَى، ثَانِيَةً، ثَالِثَةً) and on the clock (السَّاعَةُ السَّادِسَةُ، الثَّامِنَةُ)، counting 3–10 with the plural (ثَلَاثُ تَمَرَاتٍ، ثَلَاثُ سَاعَاتٍ)، and أَمَّا ... فَـ for contrast

sentences.ar: فِي يَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَيَّامِ، اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحْمَدُ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ صَبَاحًا، وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ فَطُورًا لَذِيذًا.
sentences.en: One day, Ahmad woke up at six in the morning, and wanted to eat a delicious breakfast.
sentences.tr: fī yawmin mina l-ayyām, istayqaẓa aḥmadu fī s-sāʿati s-sādisati ṣabāḥan, wa-arāda an yaʾkula faṭūran ladhīdhan

sentences.ar: أَكَلَ بَيْضَةً أُولَى، ثُمَّ أَكَلَ ثَانِيَةً وَثَالِثَةً، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَكَلَ ثَلَاثَ تَمَرَاتٍ وَجَوْزَةً.
sentences.en: He ate a first egg, then ate a second and a third, and after that he ate three dates and a walnut.
sentences.tr: akala bayḍatan ūlā, thumma akala thāniyatan wa-thālithah, wa-baʿda dhālika akala thalātha tamarātin wa-jawzah

sentences.ar: شَرِبَ كَأْسًا مِنَ الحَلِيبِ، وَأَكَلَ قِطْعَةَ خُبْزٍ مَعَ الجُبْنِ.
sentences.en: He drank a glass of milk, and ate a piece of bread with cheese.
sentences.tr: shariba kaʾsan mina l-ḥalīb, wa-akala qiṭʿata khubzin maʿa l-jubn

sentences.ar: فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ، ذَهَبَ أَحْمَدُ مَعَ عَائِلَتِهِ إِلَى القَرْيَةِ.
sentences.en: At eight o'clock, Ahmad went with his family to the village.
sentences.tr: fī s-sāʿati th-thāminah, dhahaba aḥmadu maʿa ʿāʾilatihi ilā l-qaryah

sentences.ar: وَفِي الطَّرِيقِ، رَأَى دَجَاجًا وَسَمَكًا فِي مَتْجَرٍ صَغِيرٍ، وَاشْتَرَى سَلَطَةً وَسَمْنًا وَسُكَّرًا.
sentences.en: And on the way, he saw chicken and fish in a small shop, and bought salad, ghee and sugar.
sentences.tr: wa-fī ṭ-ṭarīq, raʾā dajājan wa-samakan fī matjarin ṣaghīr, wa-shtarā salaṭatan wa-samnan wa-sukkaran

sentences.ar: وَعِنْدَمَا وَصَلُوا، جَلَسُوا تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ، وَشَرِبُوا الشَّايَ وَالقَهْوَةَ.
sentences.en: And when they arrived, they sat under a big tree, and drank tea and coffee.
sentences.tr: wa-ʿindamā waṣalū, jalasū taḥta shajaratin kabīrah, wa-sharibū sh-shāya wa-l-qahwah

sentences.ar: قَالَ أَحْمَدُ: «أَنَا عَطْشَانُ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ مَاءً». فَقَالَتْ أُمُّهُ: «تَفَضَّلْ، يَا أَحْمَدُ!».
sentences.en: Ahmad said: "I am thirsty, I want to drink water." So his mother said: "Here you go, Ahmad!"
sentences.tr: qāla aḥmad: anā ʿaṭshān, urīdu an ashraba māʾan. fa-qālat ummuh: tafaḍḍal, yā aḥmad!

sentences.ar: بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، شَعَرَ أَحْمَدُ بِالجُوعِ، فَقَالَ: «أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ طَعَامًا لَذِيذًا».
sentences.en: After that, Ahmad felt hungry, so he said: "I want to eat delicious food."
sentences.tr: baʿda dhālik, shaʿara aḥmadu bi-l-jūʿ, fa-qāl: urīdu an ākula ṭaʿāman ladhīdhan

sentences.ar: فَطَلَبَتْ أُمُّهُ لَحْمًا، وَطَلَبَ أَبُوهُ سَمَكًا، أَمَّا أُخْتُهُ فَطَلَبَتْ دَجَاجًا.
sentences.en: So his mother ordered meat, and his father ordered fish; as for his sister, she ordered chicken.
sentences.tr: fa-ṭalabat ummuhu laḥman, wa-ṭalaba abūhu samakan, ammā ukhtuhu fa-ṭalabat dajājan

sentences.ar: وَكَانَ الطَّعَامُ شَهِيًّا جِدًّا، وَشَكَرَ أَحْمَدُ أُمَّهُ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ.
sentences.en: And the food was very delicious, and Ahmad thanked his mother for the food.
sentences.tr: wa-kāna ṭ-ṭaʿāmu shahiyyan jiddan, wa-shakara aḥmadu ummahu ʿalā ṭ-ṭaʿām

sentences.ar: بَعْدَ الغَدَاءِ، لَعِبَ أَحْمَدُ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِهِ ثَلَاثَ سَاعَاتٍ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبُوا إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ.
sentences.en: After lunch, Ahmad played with his friends for three hours, then they went to the garden.
sentences.tr: baʿda l-ghadāʾ, laʿiba aḥmadu maʿa aṣdiqāʾihi thalātha sāʿāt, thumma dhahabū ilā l-ḥadīqah

sentences.ar: رَأَى أَحْمَدُ رَجُلًا غَنِيًّا يَشْتَرِي فَاكِهَةً وَعِنَبًا، وَرَأَى طِفْلًا فَقِيرًا لَا يَمْلِكُ ثَمَنَ الطَّعَامِ، فَأَعْطَاهُ بَعْضَ الفَاكِهَةِ.
sentences.en: Ahmad saw a rich man buying fruit and grapes, and saw a poor child who did not have the price of food, so he gave him some of the fruit.
sentences.tr: raʾā aḥmadu rajulan ghaniyyan yashtarī fākihatan wa-ʿinaban, wa-raʾā ṭiflan faqīran lā yamliku thamana ṭ-ṭaʿām, fa-aʿṭāhu baʿḍa l-fākihah

sentences.ar: قَالَ أَحْمَدُ: «أَنَا أُفَضِّلُ مُسَاعَدَةَ الفُقَرَاءِ، وَأُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ كَرِيمًا».
sentences.en: Ahmad said: "I prefer helping the poor, and I love to be generous."
sentences.tr: qāla aḥmad: anā ufaḍḍilu musāʿadata l-fuqarāʾ, wa-uḥibbu an akūna karīman

sentences.ar: فِي عَشَاءِ ذَلِكَ اليَوْمِ، أَكَلَتِ العَائِلَةُ طَعَامًا خَفِيفًا، ثُمَّ شَرِبُوا الشَّايَ.
sentences.en: At dinner that day, the family ate a light meal, then they drank tea.
sentences.tr: fī ʿashāʾi dhālika l-yawm, akalati l-ʿāʾilatu ṭaʿāman khafīfan, thumma sharibū sh-shāy

sentences.ar: قَالَتِ الأُمُّ: «لِمَاذَا لَا نَذْهَبُ إِلَى القَرْيَةِ مَرَّةً ثَانِيَةً الأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ؟».
sentences.en: The mother said: "Why don't we go to the village again next week?"
sentences.tr: qālati l-umm: limādhā lā nadhhabu ilā l-qaryati marratan thāniyatan al-usbūʿa l-qādim?

sentences.en: Ahmad was very happy and said: "A wonderful idea!"
sentences.tr: fariḥa aḥmadu kathīran wa-qāl: fikratun rāʾiʿah!

sentences.ar: وَفِي اليَوْمِ التَّالِي، ذَهَبَ أَحْمَدُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، وَكَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ مَادَّةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالصِّحَّةِ.
sentences.en: And the next day, Ahmad went to school, and he had a new subject about food and health.
sentences.tr: wa-fī l-yawmi t-tālī, dhahaba aḥmadu ilā l-madrasah, wa-kānat ʿindahu māddatun jadīdatun ʿani ṭ-ṭaʿāmi wa-ṣ-ṣiḥḥah

sentences.ar: تَعَلَّمَ أَنَّ الوَجَبَاتِ الصِّحِّيَّةَ مُهِمَّةٌ لِلْجِسْمِ، وَأَنَّ وَجْبَةً وَاحِدَةً لَا تَكْفِي طَوَالَ اليَوْمِ.
sentences.en: He learnt that healthy meals are important for the body, and that one meal is not enough for the whole day.
sentences.tr: taʿallama anna l-wajabāti ṣ-ṣiḥḥiyyata muhimmatun li-l-jism, wa-anna wajbatan wāḥidatan lā takfī ṭawāla l-yawm

sentences.ar: وَعِنْدَمَا عَادَ إِلَى البَيْتِ، قَالَ لِأُمِّهِ: «أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَنَاوَلَ طَعَامًا صِحِّيًّا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ!».
sentences.en: And when he returned home, he said to his mother: "I want to eat healthy food every day!"
sentences.tr: wa-ʿindamā ʿāda ilā l-bayt, qāla li-ummih: urīdu an atanāwala ṭaʿāman ṣiḥḥiyyan kulla yawm!

vocab.note: you know أَسْتَيْقِظُ (I wake up) — same verb, past tense, he
أُرِيدُ (I want) in the past, for him
Qur'an: أَلَمْ تَرَ — have you not seen (105:1)
جَلَسَ he sat; مَجْلِس a sitting-place
شَعَرَ بِالجُوعِ — felt hunger; always with بِـ
لَا يَمْلِكُ — does not have; Qur'an: مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
root ع-ل-م; عَلَّمَ to teach, تَعَلَّمَ to learn
you know أَعُودُ (I return) — past, he

translate.en: At eight o'clock, Ahmad went with his family to the village.
translate.ar: فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ، ذَهَبَ أَحْمَدُ مَعَ عَائِلَتِهِ إِلَى القَرْيَةِ.

translate.en: One meal is not enough for the whole day.
translate.ar: وَجْبَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَا تَكْفِي طَوَالَ اليَوْمِ.
